title: ロシア産原油を載せた制裁タンカーが愛媛沖に到着、まもなく接岸 　太陽石油が受け入れへ
extracted_text: 欧州連合（EU）や米国を含む5カ国から経済制裁を受けるロシア関連の原油タンカー「ボイジャー」が4日、ロシア産原油を積載して、愛媛県今治市の菊間港沖に到着した。ホルムズ海峡封鎖後に中東産原油の調達が滞る中で、ロシア産原油が輸入されるのは初めて。4日正午ごろに、菊間港周辺にある太陽石油（東京都千代田区）の石油施設につながる桟橋に横付けするとみられる。 午前3時20分ごろ、真っ暗な菊間港沖に、船の中央に黄色いライトを灯したボイジャーが姿を見せた。船首の強いライトが点灯すると、「POWERED BY NATURAL GAS」と書かれた緑色の船体が闇夜に浮かび上がった。その後は船橋のライトも点灯させて停泊。石油施設の北東約4キロの位置で、接岸作業を待っているとみられる。 ボイジャーは、米国やEUによる制裁の例外となっているサハリン（樺太）の石油・天然ガス開発事業「サハリン2」で生産された原油を積載している。昨年6月にも、この石油施設へ原油を運んでいた。 太陽石油によると、経済産業省から昨年と同様に原油受け入れの依頼があった。ボイジャーによる輸入は制裁対象にはなっていないという。同社は2022年のウクライナ侵略後にロシア産原油の取引を中止し、経産省の要請があった場合のみ輸入している。 船舶の位置情報を提供するサイト「マリントラフィック」によると、ボイジャーは4月24日にサハリンのプリゴロドノエ港を出港し、日本海沿岸のナホトカ湾を経由して、1日に大隅海峡（鹿児島）を通過。2日から3日にかけて宮崎沖で港外停泊を行った後、4日午前3時20分ごろに今治市沖に到着した。
translated_text: A Russia-linked crude oil tanker called Voyager, which is subject to economic sanctions from five countries including the European Union (EU) and the United States, arrived off the port of Kikuma in Imari City, Ehime Prefecture on the 4th, carrying Russian crude oil. This marks the first time Russian crude oil has been imported since Middle Eastern oil supplies became disrupted after the Strait of Hormuz was blocked. Around noon on the 4th, the vessel is expected to dock at a wharf connected to Taiyo Oil's petroleum facility (Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo) near Kikuma Port. At around 3:20 a.m., the Voyager, with a yellow light shining from the center of the ship, came into view in the darkness off Kikuma Port. When the strong spotlight on the bow was turned on, a green hull displaying "POWERED BY NATURAL GAS" emerged into the night. Afterward, the bridge lights were also turned on and the vessel anchored. It appears to be waiting for berthing operations about 4 kilometers northeast of the petroleum facility. The Voyager is carrying crude oil produced at the Sakhalin (Karafuto) oil and natural gas development project "Sakhalin-2," which is exempt from sanctions by the US and EU. It also delivered crude oil to this petroleum facility in June last year. According to Taiyo Oil, the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry requested that they accept crude oil in the same manner as the previous year. Imports via the Voyager are not subject to sanctions, the company said. The company halted Russian crude oil transactions following Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022 and only imports when requested by METI. According to the maritime tracking site Marinetraffic, the Voyager departed from the port of Prigorodnoye in Sakhalin on April 24, passed through Nakhodka Bay along the coast of the Sea of Japan, crossed the Osumi Strait (Kagoshima) on the 1st, and anchored off Miyazaki from the 2nd to the 3rd. It arrived off Imari City at around 3:20 a.m. on the 4th.
title_en: Sanctioned Tanker Carrying Russian Crude Oil Arrives off Ehime, Expected to Dock Soon; Taiyo Oil to Accept
